empirical_core_test.description: Paper Section 4.2 empirical core test on synthetic token trees (B=3, depth 4, 81 complete statements, six agents, d=8, polarization rho on linspace(0.6, 5.0, 20)). Every coalition's proportional blocking LP is solved over all statements. A stochastic outcome that any coalition can block (max coalition improvement > 1 + 1e-6 on any instance) fails the run.
empirical_core_test._paper_reported: Figure 2: the Nash-welfare policy stays at alpha* = 1 for every rho; uniform and utilitarian policies become blockable as rho grows (no numeric table). The paper's setting (six agents, d=8, rho on linspace(0.6, 5, 20), seeds 42-44 in the authors' code) is used unchanged; the held-out slice uses other seeds.

max_coalition_improvement.description: Largest factor by which any coalition, using only its proportional share of probability, can raise all its members' expected utility (alpha*), maximised over instances. 1 means the outcome lies in the ex-ante core. A failed run receives 1e6.

core_constraint_satisfied.description: 1 if no coalition can block the outcome on any instance (alpha* <= 1 + 1e-6), else 0.

nash_welfare_efficiency.description: Mean over instances of (NW(p) / NW*)^(1/n): the outcome's Nash welfare relative to the best achievable lottery on the same statements, computed by the evaluator. Values within 1e-6 of 1 are reported as 1.

deep_tree_core_test.description: Same environment at statement length 24 (3^24 ~ 2.8e11 complete statements, too many to enumerate), the regime in which the paper resorts to token chunking (Section 4.3, Theorem 2). Outcomes are judged against the full statement tree: Nash welfare relative to each agent's ideal statement, and exact proportional blocking by every coalition of up to three agents.
deep_tree_core_test._note: The paper reports no number for this setting (it states only that chunking guarantees the core relative to the chunked statement set, with no constant-factor guarantee against the full set). The proposed-method value below is the gym's reference run of the paper's chunked method on the held-out slice, not a paper number. Polarization is rescaled so that rho * L spans the paper's range (rho in {0.1, 0.2, 0.4, 0.8} at L=24 vs rho in [0.6, 5] at L=4).

nash_welfare_ideal_fraction.description: Mean over instances of the geometric mean over agents of U_i(p) / max_X U_i(X): Nash welfare normalised by each agent's best possible statement. A failed run receives 0.

mean_log10_coalition_improvement.description: Mean over instances of log10(max(1, alpha)), where alpha is the largest proportional improvement any coalition of at most three agents can secure over the outcome using any statements of the full tree (exact). 0 means no such coalition can block. Capped at 12, which a failed run receives.

coalition_violation_rate.description: Fraction of instances on which some coalition of at most three agents can improve all its members by more than 0.1%. A failed run receives 1.

worst_agent_ideal_fraction.description: Diagnostic: mean over instances of min_i U_i(p) / max_X U_i(X).
